title: MandatoryGate
description: A non-compensatory hard requirement (ActionGate parity). Failure of ANY mandatory gate cannot be compensated by high compatibility, confidence, or Overall Fit Index. A gate whose deciding evidence was never admitted is INDETERMINATE (fail-closed) and blocks eligibility exactly as FAILED does.

predicate.description: Typed predicate over ADMITTED evidence. Interpreted by the Decision Authority; never reads the Overall Fit Index.

expression.description: Declarative predicate, e.g. "has(CERTIFICATION where name in required_certs)".

evidence_types.description: Evidence types whose admission this gate depends on.

status.description: INDETERMINATE when deciding evidence was not admitted; blocks eligibility (resolvable only by admitting evidence, never by fit).

deciding_evidence.description: Evidence Lineage node ids that produced this status.

const.non_compensatory: A FAILED or INDETERMINATE mandatory gate cannot be overridden by any dimension score, confidence, or OFI.
const.no_ofi_dependency: predicate MUST NOT reference the Overall Fit Index.
